project.name: cargotracker

layers.name: Interfaces / Delivery
layers.description: Django views, forms, REST endpoints, tracking presenters and management commands exposing the bounded contexts.

layers.name: Application Services
layers.description: Use-case orchestration for tracking, handling registration and sample data.

layers.name: Domain Model
layers.description: Entities, value objects, aggregates and repository contracts of cargo, handling, location and voyage contexts.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Persistence
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations and schema migrations.

layers.name: Templates / UI
layers.description: Django HTML templates for tracking pages and map frame.

layers.name: Project Configuration & Composition
layers.description: Settings, URL routing, WSGI/ASGI entry points, app configs, package markers and composition roots wiring dependencies.

tour.title: What is Cargo Tracker?
tour.description: Start with the handling context's ubiquitous-language glossary: it defines the domain vocabulary (handling events, registration attempts) used across the DDD bounded contexts cargo, handling, location and voyage.

tour.title: Project wiring: settings, URLs, entry points
tour.description: The Django project is configured in settings.py, routes requests in urls.py, and is served via wsgi.py/asgi.py. Note each bounded context is a Django app.

tour.title: Shared value objects
tour.description: Small validated value objects—UN/LOCODE locations and voyage numbers—are the most widely depended-on building blocks.

tour.title: Voyage context
tour.description: Voyage is an entity with a schedule of carrier movements, built fluently by VoyageBuilder and accessed through a repository port.

tour.title: Cargo aggregate
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root, identified by TrackingId, combines route specification, itinerary of legs, and derived delivery status.

tour.title: Handling domain
tour.description: Handling events and history drive a cargo's delivery; registration attempts and the repository ports model how reports are received and processed.

tour.title: Application services
tour.description: Use cases orchestrate the domain: tracking lookup, accepting registration attempts, and processing them asynchronously.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Django ORM persistence
tour.description: Repository ports are implemented with Django models; Django-specific records live apart from the domain.

tour.title: Migrations and sample data
tour.description: Migrations create the schema and management commands seed data and process queued handling attempts.

tour.title: Composition roots
tour.description: Composition modules wire application services to concrete repositories, keeping dependency injection out of the domain.

tour.title: Tracking web interface
tour.description: The tracking view uses a form and presenters (status, ETA, next activity, history) with templates and htmx to render results.

tour.title: Map frame and handling REST endpoint
tour.description: An embeddable Leaflet map frame shows cargo positions, and a CSRF-exempt REST endpoint accepts handling reports.
